This [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] '''assassin''' was a criminal living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. He pretended to be a Jedi to fool [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], whom he intended to kill. Vos, with the aid of [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], saw through his disguise and killed the Gotal in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|These guys I know. Them not Jedi. Them Bad Boys.|[[Vilmarh Grahrk]], referring to the Gotal and his partner|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 19">[[Star Wars (1998) 19|''Star Wars'' (1998) 19]]</ref>}}
This [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] was one of many beings on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] who placed bets on how long the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] would survive after his memory was wiped with an overdose of [[glitteryll]]. To try to make sure he and his [[Unidentified Mandallian Giant assassin|partner]] won the bet, he acquired [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and a set of robes similar to a Jedi's. They used these to pretend to be a Jedi to fool Vos into trusting them so that they could more easily [[Death/Legends|kill]] him at the time they had bet on his death taking place. However, the criminal [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] recognized the pair and told Vos they were merely other [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] attempting to cheat. This angered the pair and they attacked Vos and Grahrk. The Gotal was slain when Vos, having retrieved his lightsaber from the Gotal's fallen partner, slashed him across the chest.
